finding.behavior: Delegates directly to ft_8008A348 with anim_blend equal to -1.0f. It adds no state-selection policy of its own. A grounded mushroom-transformation finalizer calls this wrapper; the airborne path instead invokes a stored callback.
finding.rationale: A blend-qualified wrapper name distinguishes this entry point from the implementation while preserving the established Wait family.
finding.uncertainty: The wrapper demonstrably passes -1.0f; interpreting that value as the default-blend sentinel remains provisional because the downstream blend implementation was not inspected. This is a descriptive proposal, not a recovered original name.

finding.behavior: Accepts an animation-blend argument. It first permits DownSpot and a second conditional common-state route to bypass Wait. Otherwise it handles an airborne fighter, performs Peach-parasol handling, changes to ftCo_MS_Wait using the supplied blend, conditionally invokes the DeadUpFall-related helper, and performs common and Link/Young Link setup. The ordinary action-ending dispatcher passes zero, whereas ft_8008A324 passes -1.0f.
finding.rationale: The explicit blend parameter is the directly supported distinction between this implementation and its wrapper.
finding.uncertainty: Wait is the normal destination, not an unconditional outcome. The second early-exit helper's implementation and the exact meanings of several post-entry helpers were not inspected.
